manifest.name: Phoenix
manifest.workers: One BEAM node; one scheduler online per CPU the container may use (2)
manifest.database_layer: Ecto 3.14 with Postgrex, pool of DB_POOL_SIZE (16) connections

phase2.validation: Schemaless Ecto changesets for the query string, the JSON body and the form: 422; the id cast with Ecto.Type.cast: 400 for a non-integer; malformed JSON 400

csrf.mechanism: protect_from_forgery (:browser pipeline, Plug.CSRFProtection): token in the signed cookie session, masked _csrf_token field; 403

session.mechanism: mix phx.gen.auth: a session token in the signed cookie session, looked up in users_tokens joined with users (one query); bcrypt_elixir on users.password_bcrypt

manifest.notes: mix phx.new and mix phx.gen.release --docker; the generated force_ssl excludes localhost and 127.0.0.1.

manifest.name: Axum
manifest.workers: Tokio multi-threaded runtime, one worker per available CPU (2)
manifest.database_layer: SQLx 0.9 (Axum has no ORM; its examples use SQLx)

phase2.validation: Path, Query, Json and Form extractors (type errors: 400, Json data errors 422); ranges checked by hand (422)

csrf.mechanism: axum_csrf 0.12 (token in an encrypted cookie, HMAC in the form field)

manifest.notes: Baseline: every job measures it on the same runner as the framework under test.
